source_semantics.selection: The Sites workspace selects visible site profiles with a maximum of 100 IDs per bulk operation.
source_semantics.confirmation: ConfirmBulkDeleteAsync runs only after an explicit destructive confirmation dialog.
source_semantics.authoritative_mutation: SiteWebService.DeleteSitesAsync validates the complete selected ownership set before deleting any site and preserves the existing active-execution deletion guard.
source_semantics.post_mutation: The source clears selection and reloads authoritative site state after successful deletion.

laravel_adaptation.frontend: resources/js/sites-bulk-delete-control.tsx renders real tenant site rows, checkbox selection capped at 100, an explicit confirmation dialog, canonical operation marker, DELETE mutation, and authoritative reconciliation.
laravel_adaptation.tenant_preflight: The complete ID set is reread without global scopes but constrained to the active TenantContext tenant; any missing or foreign ID returns 404 before mutation.
laravel_adaptation.execution_preflight: Any queued or running execution for a selected owned site returns 409 before mutation.
laravel_adaptation.atomicity: Only a fully validated set reaches the database transaction; every selected Site model is deleted inside that transaction.
laravel_adaptation.reconciliation: The frontend rereads the bulk selector collection and invalidates the existing Sites workspace query after mutation; no optimistic success rows are synthesized.

proofs: exact canonical operation identity and critical tenant-owned classification
production canonical operation marker on the destructive confirmation control
explicit guarded route and real controller binding
mixed owned and foreign site IDs return 404 before any owned site is deleted
active execution returns 409 before any selected site is deleted
valid owned selection deletes as one governed batch and authoritative GET reread is empty
